pages.title: Undecorated Christmas Tree with Layered Fir Branches and a Visible Trunk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page presents an undecorated Christmas tree with layered fir branches and a visible trunk, standing alone against a plain open white background. Sweeping tiers widen toward the bottom, with shorter inner strokes suggesting overlapping foliage. The coloring sheet leaves generous spaces throughout the branches, while the trunk has narrow bark lines and flared roots.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Topped with a Star and Surrounded By Wrapped Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree topped with a faceted star stands among wrapped presents in this printable coloring page, decorated with bead garlands, round baubles, and bows. Striped and zigzag ornament patterns echo the ribbons around the gift boxes below. The coloring sheet combines broad branch spaces with small beads, bow loops, dotted wrapping, and the tree's round container.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Covered with Candy Canes, Peppermint Sweets, and Lollipop Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas tree covered with striped candy canes, peppermint sweets, and bow-tied lollipop ornaments beneath a large star topper. Strings of round beads curve between the layered fir branches, which sit above a paneled pot. Spiral candy segments, narrow cane stripes, and small bow loops provide repeated enclosed details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Hung with Paper Chains, Folded Paper Stars, and Handmade Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree hung with paper chains, folded stars, and handmade ornaments fills this printable coloring page, with a large faceted star at the top. Gingerbread figures, a tiny house, a heart, and an angel hang between looping chains. The coloring sheet includes narrow chain links, patterned baubles, and folded star sections around broader areas of fir foliage.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decorated with Pinecones, Dried Orange Slices, and Berry Garlands Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree decorated with pinecones, dried orange slices, and berry garlands appears in this printable coloring page, with dense layered foliage and an exposed trunk. Circular citrus ornaments hang between rows of overlapping pinecone scales and round berries. The coloring sheet offers many small enclosed sections in the fruit, cones, and garlands, with wider gaps between branch tiers.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Covered with Poinsettia Flowers and Cascading Ribbon Bows Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas tree covered with poinsettia flowers and cascading ribbon bows, arranged across densely layered branches above an exposed trunk. Large pointed petals surround small clustered centers, while long ribbon tails curve between the blossoms. The coloring sheet contrasts broad bow loops and petals with finer leaf veins, narrow fir tips, and delicate ribbon folds.

pages.title: Victorian Christmas Tree with Candle Holders, Glass Ornaments, and a Rocking Horse Beneath Coloring Page
pages.description: A Victorian Christmas tree with candle holders and glass ornaments stands above a rocking horse in this printable coloring page, topped by a narrow eight-point star. Bead garlands cross patterned round baubles and long teardrop decorations, with presents near the trunk. The coloring sheet includes fine candle flames, saddle details, curved rockers, and many small ornament sections.

pages.title: Tabletop Christmas Tree in a Woven Basket Beside a Frosty Kitchen Window Coloring Page
pages.description: A tabletop Christmas tree sits in a woven basket beside a frosty kitchen window in this printable coloring page, decorated with baubles, bows, and bead strands. Snowflake shapes cover the window panes, and a large star tops the tree. The coloring sheet combines basket weave and rope handles with patterned ornaments, narrow fir tips, and broad tabletop boards.

pages.title: Smiling Christmas Tree Character Holding a Wrapped Gift with Its Branch Arms Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a smiling Christmas tree character holding a wrapped gift with its branch arms, standing in a pot beneath a star. Round baubles hang around its large eyes and open smile, while a wide bow tops the present. Broad foliage and gift panels fill the coloring sheet, with smaller ribbon loops and ornament caps.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Shaped Gingerbread Cookie with Icing Garlands and Candy Ornaments on a Plate Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree-shaped gingerbread cookie rests on a round plate in this printable coloring page, decorated with wavy icing garlands and large circular candy ornaments. A star-shaped icing outline fills the pointed top, and smaller candy dots sit between the larger sweets. The coloring sheet has broad cookie tiers, narrow icing bands, and two concentric lines around the plate.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Inside a Snow Globe with Tiny Houses Around Its Base Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree stands inside a snow globe with three tiny houses around its base in this printable coloring page, beneath large falling snowflakes. Round baubles, ribbon garlands, and bows decorate the central tree, while small firs rise behind the cottages. The coloring sheet includes broad globe and base sections, with smaller window panes, roof edges, and branching snowflakes.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Mandala with Small Fir Trees Radiating Around a Central Star Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page arranges small fir trees around a central star in a Christmas tree mandala, with round baubles and snowflakes around the perimeter. Each tree has a star topper and simple hanging decorations, rotated to form a circular pattern. The coloring sheet uses clear repeated shapes, open spaces, and small dots between its larger winter motifs.

pages.title: Christmas Tree with Symmetrical Branches Decorated with Bird, Heart, and Wooden Horse Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree with symmetrical branches holds bird, heart, and wooden horse ornaments in this printable coloring page, crowned by a large faceted star. Paired decorations face each other across the tree, while smaller leaf and scallop patterns fill the hearts and horses. The coloring sheet balances broad branch tiers with tiny ornamental dots, wings, and hanging loops.

pages.title: Christmas Tree with Tiers Divided Into Spirals, Scallops, Diamonds, and Leaf Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page divides a Christmas tree into patterned tiers of spirals, scallops, diamonds, and leaves, with a faceted star at the top. Each broad level has a different repeated motif, and simple bark lines run down the exposed trunk. The coloring sheet offers large enclosed geometric and leaf shapes with strong outlines and an open background.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Hung with Miniature Teddy Bears, Toy Drums, Rocking Horses, and Wooden Trains Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree hung with miniature teddy bears, toy drums, rocking horses, and wooden trains fills this printable coloring page beneath a large star topper. The paired toy ornaments hang from short loops among sweeping fir branches. The coloring sheet includes bear bow ties, drum lacing, train wheels, and horse saddles, with wider spaces between the tree's detailed outer tips.

pages.title: Angel Topped Christmas Tree with a Small Nativity Scene Arranged Beneath Its Branches Coloring Page
pages.description: An angel tops a Christmas tree above a small Nativity scene in this printable coloring page, with stars, baubles, and textured garlands across the branches. Mary and Joseph kneel beside the manger under a shelter, with a lamb and donkey nearby. The coloring sheet offers broad tree tiers alongside smaller angel wings, stable boards, wrapped gifts, and animal outlines.

pages.title: Christmas Tree with a Toy Train Circling the Trunk on a Round Track Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree rises above a toy train circling its trunk on a round track in this printable coloring page, decorated with baubles and bows. The locomotive pulls two cars beneath bead garlands and ornaments patterned with stars, stripes, and snowflakes. The coloring sheet includes small train wheels, track ties, and decoration details around the tree's broad layered branches.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Beside a Brick Fireplace with Stockings Hanging From the Mantel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places a Christmas tree beside a brick fireplace, with four patterned stockings hanging beneath holly and a bow on the mantel. Candy canes and bead garlands decorate the tree above a cluster of wrapped gifts. The coloring sheet includes broad branch areas and presents, balanced by stocking motifs, brick joints, flames, and narrow ribbon strips.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Seen Through a Bay Window From a Garden Covered in Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree appears through a bay window from a snow-covered garden in this printable coloring page, framed by tied curtains and narrow side panes. Baubles, bead strands, and bows cover the tree above several presents inside the house. The coloring sheet includes wide snowbanks and window trim, with smaller garden twigs, ornament shapes, and curtain folds.

pages.title: Christmas Tree at the Foot of a Curved Staircase Wrapped in Holiday Garlands Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas tree at the foot of a curved staircase wrapped in holiday garlands, with large bows along the banister. Round and teardrop ornaments hang among bead strands, while another bow decorates the tree's base. The coloring sheet combines broad fir branches with slender spindles, stair edges, fine garland foliage, and small ornament loops.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Towering Over Village Carolers Gathered in a Snowy Town Square Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree towers over three village carolers gathered in a snowy town square in this printable coloring page, framed by cottages and two streetlamps. Each singer holds an open book beneath the tree's stars, baubles, and large ribbon bows. The coloring sheet mixes broad winter coats and fir branches with smaller book edges, beads, boot laces, and lamp frames.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Beside a Frozen Pond Where Children Are Ice Skating Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas tree beside a frozen pond where two children ice-skate, extending their arms above curved tracks in the ice. Round ornaments, bows, and bead garlands cover the tree beneath its star topper. The coloring sheet offers broad snowbanks and open pond areas, with smaller skate blades, coat buttons, scarf fringes, and ornament stripes.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Outside a Log Cabin with a Sled Leaning Against the Porch Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree stands outside a log cabin with a sled leaning against the porch in this printable coloring page, beneath a star and bead garlands. A hanging lantern marks the cabin entrance, while snow caps the roof, chimney, and porch rails. The coloring sheet includes wide tree branches, rounded log ends, narrow sled boards, and small window panes.

pages.title: Family Choosing a Christmas Tree Among Rows of Firs at a Snowy Tree Farm Coloring Page
pages.description: A family chooses a Christmas tree among rows of firs at a snowy tree farm in this printable coloring page, with one parent pointing toward the branches. A child holds the other parent's hand beside the large foreground tree. The coloring sheet includes layered fir tips, winter coat panels, striped hat cuffs, and long scarves against simple rolling snowbanks.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Tied Securely in the Bed of a Pickup Truck on a Snowy Country Road Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas tree tied securely in a pickup truck bed on a snowy country road, with ropes crossing its branches. The rear view reveals the tailgate, round lights, wide tires, and tracks curving toward distant fir trees. The coloring sheet contrasts broad truck panels with fine rope twists, tire treads, and densely pointed tree foliage.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Market with Upright Firs, Bundled Trees, and a Wreath Covered Wooden Stall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts a Christmas tree market with upright firs, bundled trees, and a wooden stall covered with a wreath and evergreen trim. Two tightly bound trees lean against the counter beneath a large bow-topped wreath. The coloring sheet combines broad stall planks with dense fir needles, berry circles, rope loops, and small tree stands.

pages.title: Family Decorating a Christmas Tree While a Child Hangs an Ornament on a Lower Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: A family decorates a Christmas tree while a child hangs an ornament on a lower branch in this printable coloring page, beneath a faceted star. One parent holds a box of baubles while the other adjusts a bead garland. The coloring sheet includes broad sweater panels, the child's pleated skirt, patterned ornaments, and many small beads between the fir branches.

pages.title: Two Children in Pajamas Opening Presents Beneath a Decorated Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children in pajamas open presents beneath a decorated Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with a teddy bear emerging from the girl's wrapping. The boy lifts a box lid beside her, while stars, hearts, and tiny trees pattern their clothes and gifts. The coloring sheet offers many small motifs, ornament stripes, and bow loops around the seated figures.

pages.title: Child Leaving a Plate of Cookies and a Glass of Milk Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A child leaves a plate of cookies and a glass of milk beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, wearing star-patterned pajamas and slippers. Three dotted cookies sit on a small round table below baubles, garlands, and bows. The coloring sheet includes broad tree branches and table legs, with smaller pajama stars, cookie dots, and ornament stripes.

pages.title: Santa Claus Kneeling to Place Wrapped Presents Beneath a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Santa Claus kneeling to place a wrapped present beneath a Christmas tree, beside three other ribbon-tied boxes on the floor. Large baubles and bows decorate the tree beneath a star, with wide ribbon garlands crossing the branches. The coloring sheet combines broad coat and tree shapes with fur edges, patterned ornaments, and looping gift bows.

pages.title: Two Elves Decorating a Christmas Tree, One Standing on a Short Ladder Coloring Page
pages.description: Two elves decorate a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with one standing on a short ladder to hang a bauble near the top. The other holds a loop of bead garland beneath the tree's star, round ornaments, and bows. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing panels and branches with pointed collars, curled boots, ladder rungs, and small beads.

pages.title: Reindeer Standing Beside a Decorated Christmas Tree Outside Santa's Snowy Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: A reindeer stands beside a decorated Christmas tree outside Santa's snowy workshop in this printable coloring page, with wide branching antlers above its large ears. Round baubles and bead garlands hang beneath the tree's star, while the workshop has an arched door and circular upper window. The coloring sheet includes broad snowbanks, narrow siding, antler branches, and ornament loops.

pages.title: Snowman Hanging a Bauble on an Outdoor Christmas Tree with Its Twig Hand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a snowman hanging a bauble on an outdoor Christmas tree with its twig hand, wearing a holly-trimmed top hat and scarf. Curving bead garlands and round ornaments decorate the layered branches beneath a faceted star. The coloring sheet offers broad snowball and foliage spaces, alongside small beads, hat leaves, scarf fringes, and ornament caps.

pages.title: Rabbit and Squirrel Arranging Pinecones Around a Woodland Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A rabbit and squirrel arrange pinecones around a woodland Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, seated beneath baubles and bow-tied cones on the branches. Each animal holds a cone beside several more scattered across the snow, with tall trunks behind the tree. The coloring sheet combines broad animal bodies with layered cone scales, bead garlands, and fine fur edges.

pages.title: Kitten Climbing the Lower Branches of a Christmas Tree with Tinsel Trailing Below Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten climbs the lower branches of a Christmas tree with tinsel trailing below in this printable coloring page, reaching upward beside a round bauble. Large bows and striped ornaments decorate the tree beneath its faceted star, while loose tinsel curls across the skirt. The coloring sheet mixes broad branch spaces with narrow ornament stripes, fur tufts, and textured garland edges.

pages.title: Puppy Sleeping on a Christmas Tree Skirt Between Wrapped Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: A puppy sleeps on a Christmas tree skirt between two wrapped gifts in this printable coloring page, curled beneath round ornaments, bows, and bead garlands. Its head rests on its front paws beside a tail tucked around its body. The coloring sheet includes broad tree branches and gift panels, with holly motifs on the skirt and smaller dots and stripes.

pages.title: Mouse Family Celebrating Around a Tiny Christmas Tree Inside a Cozy Burrow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a mouse family celebrating around a tiny Christmas tree inside a burrow, with two parents and two gift-holding children. A lantern rests on a shelf near a circular window, and a low table holds another present. The coloring sheet includes broad clothing and burrow walls, with tiny beads, whiskers, tree ornaments, and curved tails.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decorated with Seed Bells and Fruit Rings for Visiting Winter Birds Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree decorated with seed bells and fruit rings attracts three winter birds in this printable coloring page, with a faceted star above the branches. Apple and citrus slices hang from loops beside bell-shaped clusters of seeds, each tied with a bow. The coloring sheet provides fine feather outlines, fruit segments, seed shapes, and broad spaces between the fir tiers.

pages.title: Deer Resting Beside a Snow Covered Christmas Tree in a Forest Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: A spotted deer rests beside a snow-covered Christmas tree in a forest clearing in this printable coloring page, with its legs folded beneath its body. Striped, wavy, and snowflake-patterned baubles hang under the tree's star topper, framed by bare trunks. The coloring sheet combines broad snowbanks and deer shapes with smaller back spots, hoof lines, and ornament patterns.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Inside a Village Church Beside a Stained Glass Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places a Christmas tree inside a village church beside a stained-glass window, topped with an angel holding its hands together. Lily flowers and a large star fill the pointed window, while a pew appears beside the tree. The coloring sheet includes broad branches and floor tiles, with smaller beads, bows, glass sections, and angel feathers.

pages.title: Children Displaying Handmade Paper Ornaments on a Christmas Tree in Their Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Children display handmade paper ornaments on a classroom Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, with one hanging a folded star while the other holds a chain. Snowflakes, a gingerbread figure, and a paper heart hang above a craft table with scissors. The coloring sheet includes broad clothing panels, small chain links, window panes, and varied ornament outlines.

pages.title: Christmas Tree in a Toy Shop Window with Nutcracker Figures and a Wooden Rocking Horse Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree fills a toy shop window with two nutcracker figures and a wooden rocking horse in this printable coloring page, framed by evergreen trim. Large bows, bead strands, and patterned baubles hang above wrapped presents inside the display. The coloring sheet offers broad window panels and branches, with detailed nutcracker uniforms, horse tack, garland tips, and gift ribbons.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Standing in a Gingerbread Village with Icing Roofed Houses and Candy Fences Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas tree in a gingerbread village, surrounded by icing-roofed houses, candy fences, and a winding stepping-stone path through the snow. Hearts and arched windows decorate the cottages behind the tree's baubles, stars, and bows. The coloring sheet includes broad roof icing and fir branches alongside small candy spirals, bead garlands, and striped fence posts.

pages.title: Christmas Tree on a Snowy Hillside Beneath Sweeping Ribbons of Northern Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree stands on a snowy hillside beneath sweeping ribbons of northern lights in this printable coloring page, decorated with bows, beads, and hanging ornaments. Curving bands cross the sky between small stars, while fir trees line the distant slopes. The coloring sheet provides broad sky ribbons and snowbanks, with narrower ornament stripes, garland beads, and pointed branch tips.

pages.title: Family Posing for a Christmas Photograph Beside Their Decorated Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A family poses for a Christmas photograph beside their decorated tree in this printable coloring page, with two parents standing behind a boy and girl. Snowflake motifs mark the boy's sweater, while bows decorate the girl's dress and hair beside three gifts. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing panels with cable-knit lines, small ornaments, bead garlands, and ribbon loops.

pages.title: Christmas Tree in a Wooden Barn with a Lamb, Calf, and Donkey Gathered Nearby Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree stands in a wooden barn with a lamb, calf, and donkey gathered nearby in this printable coloring page, beneath broad roof beams. Baubles, bows, and bead garlands hang above the animals, with loose straw covering the floor. The coloring sheet contrasts large tree branches and barn boards with wool curls, calf patches, long donkey ears, and narrow straw lines.

pages.title: Christmas Tree on a Front Porch Beside a Wreath Covered Door and Winter Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas tree on a front porch beside a wreath-covered door and winter boots, with a lantern mounted on the wall. Stars, bows, and round baubles fill the tree above a large decorated planter. The coloring sheet includes broad door panels and porch steps, balanced by boot laces, wreath berries, bead garlands, and fine fir tips.

pages.title: Christmas Tree in a Railway Station Beneath a Large Clock, with Suitcases on a Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas tree stands in a railway station beneath a large clock in this printable coloring page, with two suitcases resting on a curved-arm bench. Tall arched windows and narrow columns frame the tree's baubles, bows, stars, and snowflakes. The coloring sheet combines broad floor tiles and luggage panels with finer bench slats, clock marks, and small garland beads.

pages.title: Christmas Tree on a Holiday Parade Float with Oversized Gift Boxes Around Its Base Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places a Christmas tree on a holiday parade float, with three oversized gift boxes around its base beneath a faceted star. Round baubles cover the branches, and curling streamers float beside the tree above a draped platform. The coloring sheet includes broad presents and foliage, narrow bow loops, dotted wrapping, scalloped swags, and spoked wheels.

pages.title: Spiral Christmas Tree Formed From a Curling Ribbon with Baubles Hanging Between Its Loops Coloring Page
pages.description: A spiral Christmas tree formed from a curling ribbon fills this printable coloring page, with round baubles hanging between its loops beneath a faceted star. Small outlined stars surround the ribbon as it widens into a broad lower coil. The coloring sheet provides long sweeping bands and simple circular ornaments, with narrow hanging stems and an otherwise open background.
